chat.loadModelFirst: Load a model from the Models tab first.
chat.placeholder: Type your message… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)

models.noLocal: No models yet. Search and download one below.
models.catalogNote: Tested and optimized popular open-source models for your system. Download any model suited for your needs with one click.
models.noCatalogMatch: No models matched your search criteria.
models.customSearchNote: Search and download any other model repository directly from Hugging Face.
models.projectorIncluded: Vision model: the image encoder downloads too (+{{size}}). Without both, the model cannot see images.
models.projectorMissing: Image encoder (mmproj) is missing. The model loads but cannot see images.

knowledge.noCollections: No collections yet. Create one below.
knowledge.confirmDeleteCollection: Delete the "{{name}}" collection and every document in it?
knowledge.testNote: Type a question and see which chunk comes back from which document. Chat uses the same sources.
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Ask about something in your documents
knowledge.embedEngineNote: Local embedding loads a separate model; your chat model stays loaded. Not needed if you pick a cloud provider.
knowledge.noEmbedModels: No embedding model on this machine. Download one from the Models tab (for example nomic-embed-text, bge-m3).

image.noModels: No image model. Put a GGUF or safetensors file in: {{dir}}
image.promptPlaceholder: English prompts usually give better results
image.negativePlaceholder: What you don't want: blurry, low quality…

audio.micDenied: Microphone permission denied. Allow it in your browser settings.
audio.noWhisper: whisper.cpp not found. To install: `{{command}}` — on macOS no prebuilt binary is published, so it explains the options there. With an API key you can use the cloud provider instead.
audio.noSpeechModels: No speech model. Put a ggml-*.bin file in: {{dir}}
audio.ttsUnavailable: No speech synthesizer was found on this machine. macOS and Windows use the built-in one; on Linux, install `espeak-ng` and it will be used. A cloud provider is also an option.

settings.keysNote: Keys are stored encrypted; the master key lives in the macOS Keychain, in DPAPI bound to your Windows account, or in a file only you can read on Linux. Once saved, the full value is never displayed anywhere.
settings.resourceNote: Select a power profile or set custom limits to prevent overheating, keep fans quiet, and reduce power consumption during local model inference.
settings.powerPerformanceDesc: All CPU cores and full acceleration. Highest speed, higher heat and fan noise.
settings.powerBalancedDesc: 70% of CPU cores and full acceleration. Cool, quiet, and smooth for daily use.
settings.powerEcoDesc: Reduced core count and smaller batch size. Prevents overheating and battery drain, runs slower.
settings.powerCustomDesc: Manually configure CPU core count, batch size, and accelerator settings.
settings.ubatchDesc: Smaller batch size reduces peak memory bandwidth and thermal spikes during prompt processing.
settings.gpuOffloadDesc: When disabled, the model runs strictly on CPU (slower, but completely prevents GPU heating).
settings.systemPromptPlaceholder: Instruction given to the model in every chat…
settings.resourceApplyNote: Changes take effect the next time a model is loaded. If one is running, reload it from the Models tab.

auth.missingBody: Open this page using the address printed by the launcher. Use the `http://127.0.0.1:.../#t=…` link shown in your terminal.
auth.expiredBody: The server may have restarted. Use the new link from your terminal.

error.unauthorized: Session key is invalid or missing.

agent.workspaceNote: The agent can only read, write, and run commands inside this folder. Broad folders like your home directory are rejected.
agent.empty: Give the agent a task. It picks its own tools; writing files and running commands will ask for your approval.
agent.browserMissing: Browser tools are not installed. To install: {{command}}

plan.hint: Splits the task into steps and runs each one as a separate sub-agent. For long jobs.
plan.title: Plan

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.note: Model Context Protocol servers give the agent new tools. Adding a server means running a command — check it. Unless a server declares a tool read-only, it will ask for approval.

search.title: Web search providers
search.note: Without a key we fall back to scraping DuckDuckGo, which breaks when their page changes. A Brave or Tavily key removes that fragility.
